description: Energy Atlas 2.0 is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. The Energy Atlas is a database of building energy consumption that links utility account information to building characteristics, sociodemographic data, and other significant attributes that can be expressed spatially. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Spatial planning, Town planning, Buildings, Equipment, Housing, Energy. Its keywords are buildings, energy. The portal shows 2026-01-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is No license, or terms of use, asserted by data producer for this dataset was found.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
